name: GP Savannah River Mill - Rincon GA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View on the private entrance road shows a multi-lane checkpoint canopy ~200m inside the property line with trucks staged; chain-link perimeter fencing runs along the access road; GP entrance sign at the public-road junction.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Checkpoint canopy spans the entry lanes with an adjacent booth structure visible in Street View; consistent with a staffed gatehouse at a 1000-employee mill.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive multi-row diagonal trailer drop yard immediately inside the gate; hundreds of trailers counted across z18-z19 crops, clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Banks of dock doors along the central process/converting buildings; estimate 45 in the 25-50 band, partially obscured by buildings and trailers.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail spur with rail cars runs into the SE side of the property; mill historically built by Fort Howard with rail service.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large multi-building campus: pulp/process buildings, converting, warehouse, power plant, plus a separate large DC building to the SW along Fort Howard Rd.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron with multiple lanes and ample paved width inside the gate to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identifiable in available imagery near the gate; flagged uncertain.
